test_title: PYST 56: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Study the following pie chart and answer the below question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2b3f226b0712024cfb47ad1c72199eae1bcd7af6c245da7612b245898af0fdd.png] 

How much percent is more expense on rent than the expense on others?
solution:
**Given:**

Total yearly expenses = 300000

Expense on rent = 20%

Expense on others = 10%

**Calculation:**

Expense on rent = 300000 × (1)/(5) = 60000

Expense on others = 300000 × (1)/(10) = 30000

Expense on rent is more than others by = 60000 - 30000 = 30000

So, the percentage by which expense on rent is more than expense on others

⇒ (30000/30000) × 100

⇒ 100%

**∴ The expense of rent is 100% more than the expense of others.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__****Expense on rent = 20%**

Expense on others = 10%

ATQ, 

20 - 10 = 10.

10/10 × 100 = 100%
